analyst.summary: TD Power Systems makes generators/alternators for power plants and industrial customers worldwide and is having its third straight record year, with revenue and profit both growing 35-45% and a record order book supporting FY27 guidance of ~29% revenue growth. The business is debt-free and genuinely growing, but the stock's ~74x earnings multiple already pays up for that growth continuing for several more years, and capital-goods order books can turn lumpy. We rate it a Hold: a quality growth story, but not cheap enough here to add.
